title: When the Will Breaks
author: Astrid Zhou
blurb: Hazel Crane, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
